original_question: Using the same subgroups Gi from the previous problem, define Hi = Gi cap TAn(k). Is TAn(k) generated by H1, ..., Hn? If so, is TAn(k) the amalgamated product of the Hi along pairwise intersections?
target_in_paper: Conjecture 1.1, in its group-theoretic reformulation via Proposition 1.2, with Theorem 1.3 giving the n=3, characteristic-zero case.
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the relevant tame subgroups by intersecting the previously defined ambient subgroups G_i with TA_n(k), and it points toward the paper’s actual group-theoretic issue: whether the tame automorphism group is obtained from these subgroups by generalized amalgamation along pairwise intersections. It also stays in the right local context of Conjecture 1.1 / Proposition 1.2 / Theorem 1.3.
missing_details: The paper’s sharp statement is about the generalized amalgamated product structure; the generation of TA_n(k) by the H_i is not the real conjectural content here and is treated as already available in the setup.
The ambient objects must be defined explicitly: GA_n(k), TA_n(k), and the subgroups G_i.
The subgroups G_i need their paper-faithful definition, namely as stabilizers of the standard flag pieces V_i = k ⊕ kx_1 ⊕ ... ⊕ kx_i inside k[x_1, ..., x_n] under the natural action.
The quantifiers over the base field k and the dimension n are missing.
The phrase 'amalgamated product' should be replaced by the paper’s more precise notion 'generalized amalgamated product ... along pairwise intersections'.
The draft does not mention the equivalent simplicial-complex formulation supplied by Proposition 1.2, which is the official bridge from Conjecture 1.1 to the group-theoretic question.
The draft does not indicate that Theorem 1.3 proves the conjecture in the case n = 3 and char(k) = 0, so as written it sounds fully open even in the case settled by the paper.
The notation H_i is not stand-alone because it depends on a 'previous problem'; the refined question must reintroduce all notation internally.
refined_question: Let k be a field and n ≥ 2. For 1 ≤ i ≤ n, let V_i = k ⊕ kx_1 ⊕ ··· ⊕ kx_i ⊂ k[x_1, ..., x_n], let G_i = {φ ∈ GA_n(k) : φ(V_i) = V_i}, and let H_i = G_i ∩ TA_n(k), where TA_n(k) is the tame automorphism subgroup of GA_n(k). Is TA_n(k) the generalized amalgamated product of the subgroups H_1, ..., H_n along their pairwise intersections?
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently, in the paper’s simplicial-complex language, is the tame-complex D_n simply connected?
justification: The draft is aiming at the tame analogue of the paper’s main introductory conjecture, but it is slightly broader and less sharp than the official formulation. In the paper, the key point is not whether the H_i generate TA_n(k), but whether TA_n(k) has the generalized amalgamated product structure with respect to these stabilizer-type tame subgroups. Proposition 1.2 is the explicit equivalence that turns the geometric/simple-connectivity version of Conjecture 1.1 into this group-theoretic question, and Theorem 1.3 then proves that statement in dimension 3 over a field of characteristic 0. So the closest stand-alone research question is the generalized-amalgamation question above, together with the paper’s exact definitions of G_i and H_i.
